findings.evidence: REQ-024.4 has two halves; the second ('the user never waits for a bot when no bot is to act') is not asserted by any AC. AC5 covers only 'bots never act during the user's turn', AC6/AC7 cover bots acting unprompted.
findings.fix: Add AC: Given Realistic speed and every bot has folded or is all-in so only the user can act, When the previous action completes, Then the action bar is enabled with no bot delay [REQ-024.4]

findings.evidence: AC2 checks only that every gap lies in 0.8-3.0 s; a fixed delay passes, so the 'random delay' part of REQ-011.2 is untested.
findings.fix: Add: over 200 bot actions the gaps are not all equal and span at least 0.8-1.2 s to 2.6-3.0 s (min < 1.2 s, max > 2.6 s) [REQ-011.2]

findings.evidence: S01 and S03 (m-0, ordinals 11000/14000) show face-up hole cards and card-back markers; the SVG card faces and backs are built in S05 (ordinal 20000), which neither S01 nor S03 depends on.

findings.evidence: REQ-017.1 says 'no bet facing -> Check and Bet', but preflop the big blind counts as the first bet (REQ-016.2), so the BB option in an unraised pot is Check and Raise-to. No requirement defines the label and no AC covers it.
findings.fix: User to decide: preflop BB option offers Check and 'Raise to $8' (confirm); then add the AC

findings.evidence: REQ-016.5 allows short all-in raises/bets, but REQ-017.3/022.1 define only 'Call all-in'. For a stack above the call but below a full raise (e.g. $6 facing $4) or below a full bet, the offered action and label are undefined.
findings.fix: User to decide the labels (e.g. 'Raise all-in $6' / 'Bet all-in $3') or that Raise is hidden; then add ACs

findings.evidence: Story covers 5 requirements (limit 1-3) and none of its 7 ACs asserts the headline outcome: the user plays a hand through all streets to a result.
